title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the importance of faith
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting how an individual's faith reflects their inherent nature and shapes who they become: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत। श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः॥ The Subhashitam conveys that every person's faith is in accordance with their nature, and that a person becomes what they believe in. The Prime Minister posted on X: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत। श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः॥ सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत।

श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः॥ https://t.co/4APRMTiurL — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 29, 2026 **** MJPS/SS/VJ
